fact: Sierra Leone's Cabinet approved the National Data Protection Policy and a new Data Protection and Right to Access Information Act, with the report saying the reform builds on years of consultations involving civil society groups, the media, security institutions and development partners; no consultation date is given, so the document's publication date is used.

Minister of Information and Civic Education Chernor Bah said the Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2025 concluded its final national validation, with drafting input from Parliament, local councils, security agencies, the Electoral Commission, civil society, media, academia and the private sector.

fact: The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation held the National Broadband Strategy validation workshop on 28 February 2024 in Freetown with mobile network operators, service providers, Metro Cable, Zoodlabs SL and LeoneCom among the attendees.

The Directorate of Financial Management Systems and Technology held a validation workshop on 28-29 October 2025 on the draft PFM interoperability roadmap with civil society organisations among the participants.

MoCTI's validation workshop on the National Data Governance Strategy, 7-8 August 2025, drew over 130 participants including civil society, academia and the private sector, and the strategy is said to have emerged from multistakeholder consultations.
